_comment: Node-local prompt templates, keyed by capability id. Each value is a Python str.format() template; {field} placeholders are filled from the job payload (the capability's declared fields in docs.js). These are CONTENT decisions, not architecture — replace the placeholders below with the real prompt engineering. worker.py renders these; it never embeds a prompt string.
parse-task:
Extract a single structured task from the following text. Respond with JSON only.

Text: {text}
breakdown-goal:
Break the following goal into an ordered list of milestones. Respond with JSON only.

Goal: {goal_text}
widget-generate:
Produce a WidgetSpec JSON document for the following description. Respond with JSON only.

Description: {description}
query:
You are a triage router. Classify the intent of the following query and respond with JSON only.

Query: {text}
